_readme: POSITIVE-path scenario. port = the repo's RESERVED pair via "first"/"second" (never a literal); $PORT is injected into every command's env — never hardcode a port. start is a single foreground command (the harness owns its life and kills it authoritatively). Probes: id unique, command shell, expect = space-separated tokens: status:N, json:path=value, body_contains:, body_matches:^regex$, exit:N, max_ms:N. Values must be space-free (use body_matches: with \s patterns for spaces). Size probes to the currently claimable issue — grow per lap, never front-load the whole PRD.
name: runtime

probes.description: GET /health answers 200 — the command EMITS the code; the matcher judges stdout
GET /health body is JSON ok:true (json: needs ALL of stdout to be one JSON doc)
the product's primary endpoint answers its contract (exit:0 is implicit)
